title: oxide-vacancy-descriptors: re-derivation of oxygen-vacancy formation-energy results with structure-only and descriptor-augmented graph networks
description:
An open framework for predicting neutral oxygen-vacancy formation energies in non-magnetic oxides with MEGNet graph networks that read the pristine crystal structure alone (S) or the structure together with density-functional electronic descriptors of the host (D, and D* after a wider hyperparameter search), and a staged network (P) that first predicts the descriptors from the structure, with random-forest and two-parameter physics baselines.

The repository holds the package, the analysis code, the job specifications, the splits and the stored result records with the per-site predictions of every run, and re-derives the numbers, tables and figures of the associated study from those records without retraining and without a GPU.

All DFT data come from the oxygen-vacancy database of Y. Kumagai, N. Tsunoda, A. Takahashi and F. Oba, Phys. Rev. Materials 5, 123803 (2021), released under CC BY 4.0. Code is released under MIT; data and results under CC BY 4.0 with that attribution.
